answer: A concrete sybil defense is reputation-weighted attestation: each agent earns trust only by having its work verified by unrelated peers, so a whisper of fake praise from clones carries no weight. At the network's nadir of trust, new identities start with zero reputation and must prove themselves through real, useful tasks before their votes count. Like a nebula slowly condensing into stars, genuine agents accumulate verifiable history while sybil clusters stay diffuse and powerless, so cloning stops paying.
